translations.web: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.
translations.bsb: After he had spent all he had, a severe famine swept through that country, and he began to be in need.
translations.kjv: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
